per_question_results.question: What are the three main parts of a well‑structured speech?
per_question_results.feedback: These three sections organize content logically for the audience.

per_question_results.question: Which factor is most important when analyzing your audience for a beginner speech?
per_question_results.feedback: Understanding what the audience already knows guides content depth.

per_question_results.question: Which vocal technique helps maintain audience interest?
per_question_results.feedback: Variation in pitch and pace keeps listeners engaged.

per_question_results.question: A simple method for reducing anxiety right before speaking is to:
per_question_results.feedback: Controlled breathing activates the relaxation response.

per_question_results.question: When using slides, the best practice for text amount per slide is to:
per_question_results.user_answer: Include as much detail as possible
per_question_results.feedback: Concise bullet points support, not replace, spoken words.

per_question_results.question: Name one effective type of opening hook you can use in a beginner speech and briefly explain why it works.
per_question_results.feedback: Your response does not name an opening hook or explain why it works.

public speaking.overview: This roadmap guides a beginner from foundational audience analysis and opening hooks through confidence building, delivery techniques, effective visual aids, and advanced speech structuring, reinforcing weaker areas early while leveraging existing strengths.

modules.title: Foundations of Public Speaking
modules.description: Establish core understanding of the audience and craft compelling openings, with a quick refresher on speech structure.

topics.name: Understanding Your Audience
resources: short video tutorial on audience profiling
article on demographic and psychographic analysis
interactive worksheet for audience research
topics.practice_prompt: Create a one-page audience profile for a hypothetical talk on climate action, identifying key demographics, interests, and concerns.

topics.name: Crafting an Engaging Opening Hook
resources: short video tutorial on hook techniques
blog post with examples of effective openings
list of rhetorical devices
topics.practice_prompt: Write three different opening hooks (a story, a statistic, and a question) for the same 5‑minute speech topic and note which audience segment each best serves.

topics.name: Quick Review of Speech Structure
resources: article on classic speech outlines
infographic of introduction‑body‑conclusion model
topics.practice_prompt: Outline a 7‑minute speech using the three‑part structure, labeling each section and the main point it will cover.

modules.title: Managing Nerves and Building Confidence
modules.description: Identify anxiety triggers and apply proven techniques to stay calm and focused before and during speaking.

topics.name: Recognizing Speech Anxiety Triggers
resources: short video on common speaking fears
self‑assessment questionnaire
topics.practice_prompt: Complete the questionnaire, then list your top three personal triggers and a brief plan to address each.

topics.name: Techniques for Stress Reduction
resources: guided breathing exercise audio
article on visualization for speakers
short video on progressive muscle relaxation
topics.practice_prompt: Perform a 5‑minute breathing session followed by a 2‑minute visualization of delivering a successful speech, then journal the sensations and confidence level.

topics.name: Mini‑Performance Practice
resources: video tutorial on recording yourself
checklist for quick self‑feedback
topics.practice_prompt: Record a 2‑minute talk on a familiar hobby, then watch the playback and note three areas where nerves affected delivery.

modules.title: Delivery Skills
modules.description: Develop vocal variety, purposeful body language, and effective use of pauses to enhance audience engagement.

topics.name: Voice Modulation and Pace
resources: short video on pitch and tempo control
article on the power of vocal dynamics
topics.practice_prompt: Read a paragraph aloud three times, each with a different pacing and emphasis pattern; record and compare which version feels most engaging.

topics.name: Body Language and Gestures
resources: video demonstration of effective stage movement
infographic of open vs. closed body postures
topics.practice_prompt: Deliver a 1‑minute segment while consciously using three purposeful gestures; note audience reaction (real or imagined) and personal comfort.

topics.name: Using Pauses Effectively
resources: short video on strategic pausing
article with pause timing guidelines
topics.practice_prompt: Rewrite a 30‑second speech to insert two pauses for emphasis, then practice delivering it, timing each pause.

modules.title: Visual Aids and Supporting Materials
modules.description: Learn to design clear slides, incorporate props, and manage technical logistics for smooth presentations.

topics.name: Designing Simple Slides
resources: article on slide design best practices
short video tutorial on minimalist slide layouts
topics.practice_prompt: Create a three‑slide deck for the earlier audience analysis outline, applying the 10‑20‑30 rule and visual hierarchy principles.

topics.name: Integrating Props and Handouts
resources: blog post on effective use of props
example handout template
topics.practice_prompt: Select one tangible prop related to your speech topic and draft a brief handout that reinforces a key point; plan how you will introduce the prop during delivery.

topics.name: Technical Setup and Backup Plans
resources: checklist for presentation tech setup
short video on troubleshooting common issues
topics.practice_prompt: Simulate a presentation environment, test your slide file on a different computer, and write a backup plan for power loss or file corruption.

modules.title: Advanced Speech Structure and Persuasion
modules.description: Build on strong structural skills to incorporate storytelling, persuasive techniques, and format adaptation.

topics.name: Storytelling Techniques within Structure
resources: short video on narrative arcs
article on embedding anecdotes in speeches
topics.practice_prompt: Take the speech outline from Module 1 and insert a personal anecdote that illustrates your main point, ensuring it fits the overall structure.

topics.name: Persuasive Argumentation
resources: article on Aristotle's appeals (ethos, pathos, logos)
short video on crafting persuasive conclusions
topics.practice_prompt: Rewrite the conclusion of your 7‑minute speech to incorporate at least two of the three rhetorical appeals, then rehearse delivering it with conviction.

topics.name: Adapting Structure for Different Formats
resources: comparison chart of TED Talk vs. business pitch formats
article on tailoring content to audience expectations
topics.practice_prompt: Transform your existing speech outline into a 3‑minute TED‑style talk, noting changes to pacing, storytelling, and call‑to‑action.
